verdict.rationale: Entra ID's application management docs say admins can manage an application's permissions, tokens, and certificates. That implies first-party support for scoped app credentials an agent could use, but it is a single thin mention. Nothing in the pack shows how least-privilege scoping works for a non-human or agent identity. missing for 10: explicit docs on app registrations/service principals with scoped API permissions or app roles, client secret/certificate issuance for agents, agent-specific identity features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
